integrity: Independent verification and historical-priority certification have not been performed. Computational checks are finite and are not substituted for analytic proofs.
scientific_limitations: Uniform unrooted labelled Cayley trees only; exact joint moments at n>=7 and positive covariance at n>=5; asymptotic Gaussian statement invokes an existing pattern-count theorem; not a conditional or universal tree-model result; earlier equivalent formulas may exist.
title: Joint leaf–cherry fluctuations in uniform labelled trees
